reading: Ed Sheeran talked about a problem at his concert.
He apologised for 'mistakes' at his concert.
Rapper Macklemore was removed from his tour before this show.
Other artists also left the tour.
Ticket prices went down because of this problem.
Sheeran said his promoters, not him, decided to remove Macklemore.
He also talked about the attacks on October 7, 2023, and the situation in Gaza.
Sheeran said his music is about unity, not politics.
